subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should OpenClaw expose append as `append?: boolean` on the existing `write` tool and use this PR as the landing branch, or choose a different API/branch for the canonical data-loss fix?
rationale: The need for an append primitive is well supported, and the implementation is technically plausible, but the permanent model-facing tool contract and duplicate-candidate landing choice are maintainer-owned product/API decisions.

options.title: Accept append flag on one landing branch
options.body: Approve `append?: boolean` as the smallest default-preserving write-tool extension, then land either this PR or the smaller competing branch after exact-head CI and owner review are clean.

options.title: Request a different append API
options.body: Ask contributors to reshape the implementation around a string `mode` or separate append tool if maintainers want stronger semantic separation from destructive overwrite.

options.title: Pause this branch for the competing PR
options.body: If https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102243 is selected as the canonical landing vehicle, keep this PR open only until that choice is explicit and then close it as superseded.

recommendation.title: Accept append flag on one landing branch
recommendation.body: Approve `append?: boolean` as the smallest default-preserving write-tool extension, then land either this PR or the smaller competing branch after exact-head CI and owner review are clean.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision is the agent tool API/product boundary, and steipete has the strongest adjacent ownership history for that surface.
